source: Existing 2026 ESPN player-game stats with nflverse/PFR snaps and usage enrichment

definitions.snapShare: Player offensive snaps / team offensive snaps across games with both counts
definitions.targetShare: Player recorded targets / all recorded targets for the same team in those weeks
definitions.opportunityShare: Player targets plus carries / recorded targets plus carries of teammates at the same position over the same weeks
definitions.airYardsShare: Player receiving air yards divided by all receiving air yards for the same team during matched recorded games; negative air yards are retained

limitations: 2026 completed games only; incomplete game coverage can affect shares
Team target totals are reconstructed from the snapshot, not an official team-level total
Route participation, targets per route and yards per route require independently charted routes; unavailable values remain null
